Both these appeals have been preferred on the quantum only.
The contention of the claimant is that the Tribunal has taken notional fixation for monthly income as Rs.7,500/- and the same ought to be increased.
It is seen that the accident occurred on 18.12.2015.

As per Syed Sadiq vs. Divisional Manager, United India Insurance reported in 2014 (1)
TNMAC 459 (SC) the notional fixation of salary is Rs.6500/- for the accident occurred in the year 2008.

sentences.text: When the accident occurred in the year 2015, then the notional fixation of Rs.7500/- is on the lesser side.

3. Therefore, this Court is inclined to increase notional fixation is Rs.8,000/-, as monthly income.

Monthly income is Rs. 8,000/-

sentences.text:
Annual income is Rs.10,000 x 12  Rs.1,20,000/-
 14% multiplier is to be  applied Rs.1,20,000 x 14  Rs.16,80,000/-
Since the injured is suffering 70% functional disability, for pain and suffering the Tribunal has granted Rs.50,000/-.
Therefore, this Court is inclined to double https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis the same, so that the claimant is getting Rs.1,00,000/-for pain and suffering.
As far as the extra nourishment is concerned this Court is granting a sum of Rs.50,000/-.

4. Accordingly, the claimant is entitled for compensation as follows:
S. Description Amount awarded by Award confirmed / No. enhanced / granted Tribunal this Court 1. Loss of earning power Rs. 11,49,750/- Rs.16,80,000/- Enhanced 2.
For Medical Bills Rs. 4,44,663/- Rs. 4,44,663/- Confirmed 3.
For Attendance charges Rs. 10,000/- Rs. 10,000/- Confirmed 4. For Pain and suffering Rs. 50,000/- Rs. 1,00,000/- Enhanced 5. For Transport Expenses Rs. 10,000/- Rs. 10,000/- Confirmed 6.
For Extra Nourishment Rs. 30,000/- Rs. 50,000/- Enhanced 7.

For Loss of convenience Rs. 40,000/- Rs. 40,000/- Confirmed Total Rs.
17,34,413/- Rs.23,34,663/-
Therefore, this Court is inclined to enhance a sum of Rs.23,34,663/-from Rs.17,34,413/- as compensation granted by the Tribunal. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
In view of the said modification, these Civil Miscellaneous Appeals are disposed of.

The award amount of Rs.17,34,413/- granted by the Tribunal is enhanced to Rs.23,34,663/- and the respondents in C.M.A(MD) No.1140 of 2021 is directed to deposit the same with 7.5% interest along with costs, within a period of Twelve weeks, from the date of receipt of copy of the order, less the amount if already deposited.
On such deposing being made, the claimant is permitted to withdraw the same.
The claimant is directed to pay the deficit Court fee for the enhanced compensation.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
